hook.text: Be my wife. My kingdom is yours.

who.text: King Dushyanta had found Shakuntala alone in a forest hermitage.

wait.text: Wait for my father. He will give me to you.

self.text: You are your own to give, if you wish it.

gandharva.text: He meant a gandharva marriage: their own choice, no priest, no witness.

terms.text: Then promise me: my son shall be king after you.

wed.text: He agreed at once, took her hand, and they were married.

army.text: He left, promising to send an army for her.

kanva.text: Her foster father, Kanva, came home and knew it all.

bless.text: You have done no wrong. Your son will rule the whole earth.

cliff.text: Years later she was still there: with a son who tied up lions.
